verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own sensitive-data-management tooling lets customers redact or remove stored data retroactively, which covers the deletion half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents configurable retention periods or automatic expiry; the on-premise option and event-saving controls are adjacent and do not show retention control. Missing for 10: documented configurable retention windows or auto-expiry, details on deletion scope and API-driven deletion, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: BugSnag provides a set of tools that allow customers to redact or remove sensitive data retroactively, helping ensure continued compliance with internal policies and data protection regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA.
